contact.basis: Fixed northgate east threshold source point before independent field; provider-relative model datum, not a surveyed threshold.

verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in fixed native whole Andersonville two reconstructed stockades frame. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM.4m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.

Composite DEM may not resolve timber footings or archaeological site microrelief; threshold elevation is provider-relative. Compatible host field required; default coarse terrain is not automatically certified.
